title: failure is no longer maintained
summary: The failure crate is officially end-of-life: its former maintainer marked it deprecated and announced there will be no further updates or maintenance.

constraints: Keep error types, `Display` output, and public error conversions stable for callers of this crate.

steps.title: Replace failure
steps.instructions: Replace failure with anyhow for application errors or thiserror/snafu for library error types, and update `Fail` derives, `failure::Error`, and `format_err!` uses.

verification.purpose: Build and test after the error-handling change.
